The Hidden Cost of Water Wastage

Traditional systems can miss problems until valuable water and energy have already been wasted.

💧

Undetected Leakage

Continuous leaks can remain unnoticed and increase water loss.

📊

Delayed Monitoring

Manual readings make it difficult to understand usage in real time.

🧪

Quality Uncertainty

Changes in water conditions may not be identified quickly.

⚡

Energy Wastage

Unnecessary pumping and treatment can consume additional energy.

One Smart System. Multiple Benefits.

AQUA SAVIOUR connects sensing, analytics and automated control into one conservation platform.

💧 Real-Time Water MonitoringMeasure flow, consumption and tank levels continuously.
🚨 Leakage DetectionIdentify abnormal flow patterns and generate alerts.
🧪 Water Quality TrackingMonitor selected parameters and flag unusual readings.
⚡ Energy OptimizationSupport efficient pump operation based on actual demand.
📱 Smart DashboardView live data, trends, alerts and conservation insights.
🤖 Automated ResponseEnable configured pumps, valves or other actuators to respond to defined conditions.

Technical Approach

A practical IoT architecture connecting field sensing with monitoring, analytics and automated control.

01 • Sensing LayerFlow, water-level and quality sensors collect field data from tanks, pipelines and water systems.
02 • Controller LayerAn ESP32 or suitable microcontroller processes readings and controls connected devices.
03 • Communication LayerWi-Fi or another suitable IoT method transfers readings to the monitoring platform.
04 • Cloud & Data LayerSensor data is stored and converted into trends, records and system status.
05 • Intelligence LayerThresholds and usage patterns help identify abnormal flow, leakage and overflow risk.
06 • Control & Alert LayerUsers receive alerts and configured pumps or valves can respond automatically.

Project Implementation Process

From identifying the problem to using data for conservation.

01

Define the Need

Identify water sources, consumption points, leakage risks and energy-intensive operations.

02

Build the Prototype

Connect sensors and actuators to the IoT controller and verify readings.

03

Monitor & Analyze

Display live values, historical trends and abnormal conditions on a dashboard.

04

Optimize

Use collected data to reduce water waste, prevent overflow and improve pump operation.
